column4: So the plan is to launch the beta to fifty users next Monday.
Fifty feels small. Why not a hundred?
Because support is just me right now.
Okay, fifty. But we need the feedback form working before then.
I can do it tomorrow if nobody else wants it.
Take it. I'll write the welcome email instead.
Great. And I'll pick the fifty from the waitlist tonight.
Send me the list when it's done.
